variants.text: Middle-aged male with an oblong face, high receding hairline, and thin straight eyebrows.
A middle-aged man with an oblong facial shape, high receding hairline, thin straight eyebrows, and a narrow jawline. He has a straight nose and thin lips.

Middle-aged male with an oblong facial shape, straight forehead, and high receding hairline with deep temporal recession. Features include thin straight-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double upper-lid creases, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and thin lips with a defined cupid's bow. The jawline is narrow with a rounded chin; ears are average size with attached lobes. Notable permanent features include horizontal forehead creases and nasolabial folds.

This is a middle-aged man with an oblong face and a high, receding hairline. He has thin, straight eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes. His nose is straight, and he has thin lips. You can clearly see horizontal forehead lines and some nasolabial folds on his face.
